A proposed solution involves developing a guard to block access to conflicting records in these systems.

 - Agent-memory systems fail to enforce revocation, leading to retrieval of outdated or revoked information.
 - A proposed guard mechanism could improve safety by preventing access to revoked records.

It also introduces a method to verify Binary Search Tree traversals using logarithmic memory.

The research concludes that the metric dimension behaves as β(2^X, Jac) = (2 ln 2)(n/ln n)(1+o(1)). This finding builds on previous work regarding the Jaccard distance among subsets, linking it to the Erdős–Rényi coin-weighing problem.

 - The exact asymptotic constant in the metric dimension of Jaccard space has been established.
 - The findings are significant for advancing research in discrete mathematics and related applications.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09146
